scope_decision.decision: five registered Maintenance workflows certified on the native owner route
scope_decision.included: Native workspace/detail reads, work-order create/schedule/start/block/resume/complete/cancel, downtime capture through start/complete, blocked/resume history, completion evidence/condition and immutable history.
scope_decision.excluded: Preventive-plan POST writes remain on the retained TypeScript application because the native plan command composition is not mounted.
scope_decision.retained_consumer: packages/feature-assets/src/routes/api/v1/holdings/[holdingSlug]/maintenance/plans/route.ts POST calls savePreventivePlan/changePreventivePlan. It is the named retained consumer outside the five registered workflows; removal condition is the native plan command composition.
scope_decision.follow_up: Native preventive-plan commands are a separate Maintenance follow-up and are not counted as native evidence for the five registered workflows.

native_paths.http: The private Maintenance API mounts GET workspace, GET work detail, POST create/change, GET plan list/detail and the business-error contract for the configured Holding/Company target. The duplicate target push that rejected the configured target was removed in this bundle.
native_paths.ssr: The product Maintenance GET/POST route and the detail presenter read and write through the native owner transport. There is no TypeScript owner fallback: an unset or failed transport returns 503 NATIVE_MAINTENANCE_UNAVAILABLE.
native_paths.commands: Create validates the Asset version, active-work vacancy, operational owner, Commercial new-work purchase and writes the Workflow receipt/audit, create event and notification in one serializable unit. Transitions validate the current owner or eligible reviewer, the selected work role, the state and the expected version.
native_paths.downtime: Start persists downtime_started_at and complete persists downtime_ended_at on the same work order; no separate downtime UI writer exists in this scope.
native_paths.authority: Reads require records.read plus the maintenance module and enforce the current Company/branch/department scope, selected-context expiry and bounded workspace size. Commands require records.write and the native owner/reviewer eligibility.

create.result: The native create form in the Assets & Maintenance workspace returned 200 with id maintenance-1a162f68-48d2-4441-8844-6198b7d193a0, status open, version 1; the detail page rendered the work order and its Start work / Cancel work controls.

transitions.result: Against the same work order the native owner command returned start 200 v2, block 200 v3, resume 200 v4 and complete 200 v5. PostgreSQL readback: status completed, version 5, downtime_started_at and downtime_ended_at persisted, completion_evidence 'Completed native maintenance acceptance', resulting_condition good.

browser.historical: The register's work-orders gap records that schedule/start/block/resume/complete/cancel were already native and browser verified in the earlier native slice. The only open correction was the retained TypeScript fallback in the product route, which this bundle removes.
browser.limitation: Current-session re-verification of the transition drawers was not completed: the workspace work snapshot recomputes 1295 queries for field-service-enabled roles (the cache is bypassed when actor.modules includes field_service) and the page did not finish hydration within 10 minutes. The native API transitions and PostgreSQL readback above, plus the earlier browser verification recorded in the register, are used; this environment limitation is disclosed and is not presented as new UI evidence.

legacy.product_route: apps/assets/src/app/api/v1/holdings/[holdingSlug]/maintenance/route.ts re-exports the feature route, which delegates GET/POST to the native owner transport and fails closed with 503 when it is unavailable.
legacy.plans_post: The preventive plans POST remains on the retained TypeScript application. It is outside the five registered workflows and is the named consumer for this disclosure.
legacy.preventive_tests: maintenance.maintenance-preventive.integration exercises the retained plan write application; native plan reads are covered by the native plan detail/list transport.
legacy.no_fallback: No silent TypeScript owner read or write fallback remains in the Maintenance product route.

notes: The duplicate maintenance target push in src/composition/src/private_development_api.rs was removed; the configured target now mounts once and the private API accepts the shared configuration.

The route-encoding suite binds the presenter's native detail boundary to the owner read over the same disposable database; native HTTP reads remain gated by maintenance.rust-maintenance-read-postgres.integration and the browser journey.
No 6-subagent roster or Common frozen-bundle coordination is present; this bundle follows the user-directed execution without claiming that process evidence.
surfaces_scope: The surfaces apply to the five registered Maintenance workflows. Preventive-plan POST writes are a disclosed auxiliary consumer outside this certification.
